ranked.headline: Computational frameworks resolve tissue architecture across spatial single-cell modalities

ranked.summary: Explicit encoding of prior genomic knowledge, covariates and longitudinal structure is becoming central to genetic and omics inference.

ranked.summary: Graph, GNN, and transformer models now predict combination effects, mechanistic readouts, and hepatotoxicity before experimental screening.

ranked.summary: Plasma proteomics now yields cell-type aging estimates and disease-risk archetypes in tens of thousands of adults.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints package metadata standardization, policy-driven I/O and programmatic APIs as reusable infrastructure for biological data.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints quantify how batch correction, sample design, and imputation alter downstream inference in omics and sparse biomedical data.

ranked.summary: Recent foundation, state-space, and explainable-AI models extract regulatory information from epigenomes, Hi-C maps, and cfDNA data.

ranked.summary: Foundation-model embeddings and multimodal fusion are being benchmarked and tested for robustness in cancer and molecular prediction tasks.

ranked.summary: Recent studies resolve genomic variation at individual loci, spanning ortholog loss, histone hypermutability and ancestry-enriched pathogenic variants.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers constrain LLMs and interpretable ML with structured evidence and grounded retrieval for biological prediction.

ranked.summary: OGGfinder reports outperforming OrthoFinder, CD-HIT and TreeCluster on pan-gene families, alongside new published tools for alignment and read classification.

ranked.summary: Three June 2026 studies pair geometric or curvature-based encodings with graph models for protein-ligand and drug-target affinity prediction.

ranked.summary: Multiscale backbone recovery, real-time residue-wise validation, and local fitting now target cryo-EM maps across a range of resolutions.
